name: Molecular Weight
description: Compute the molecular weight of a compound from its element list. Each element's atomic mass is stored in the preloaded constant table (indexed by atomic number); CHEM_MASS looks up the mass for each element in the input stream, and an accumulator sums across all atoms in the molecule. The preloaded-table model means no arithmetic is required for the lookup — the cell decodes address to value structurally. Output is in unified atomic mass units (u = g/mol).
author: system

pipeline.note: Atomic mass lookup (u) from preloaded table indexed by atomic number
Downstream: MIF_ADD accumulator sums atom masses to molecular weight

expected_output: molecular_weight (MIF float, unified atomic mass units)
